notes: Export PDF: Only the selected objects, and Border and title box: Hide, so only your drawing fills the whole page.
Export PDF: Fill the whole page (default) and Auto page direction make the drawing or picked area fill the paper. A live page preview shows before you save; tap it to see it big.
After every update, a box now shows what changed (Home ⋮ › What’s new shows it again any time).
Text size: the Text box has A− / A+ buttons, a size box and quick sizes, with a preview. Select texts, room names or dimensions and tap A− Text or A+ Text to make them smaller or bigger.
Fixed: on phones the Text tool (and other boxes that open from a tap on the drawing) closed straight away before you could type.

My tools panel: Properties, Zoom fit, Undo, Redo, Layers and Erase removed (they are in the top bar or select options). Added Chamfer, Corner, Join, Explode, Aligned and Angular dimension, Room, Measure, Colour and Railing.
